title: Angry Dad Endangers His 2-Year-Old Son After Refusing To Listen To Police
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 3rd, 2023. Officers were dispatched to a residence about a disturbance. The caller stated that the suspect(Justin) was outside her apartment tapping the window after being locked out and it was also mentioned that the suspect lived in that same apartment with his son and girlfriend. When officers spoke with the caller, she stated that the reason for her actions was because she had a Marchman Act in place for Justin. (Marchman Act:  a civil procedure that allows a spouse, relative, legal guardian, friend, sheriff, or treatment center representative who is concerned about a person's behaviour to petition the court and seek help for an individual suspected of having a substance abuse problem.) When the officers had this information and told Justin that he had to come with them, he immediately became argumentative and refused to listen and comply with the officers. He stated that he was not leaving to go anywhere and he didn't want to leave his son behind. He then proceeded to lock himself and his 2-year-old son in his truck.  This is footage of the events that followed.
